'''Chapter 427''' is titled "It's Not Like it's Hell Here".

==Cover Page==
[[Where They Are Now]], Shot 3: "[[Gan Fall]] and the [[Shandian Chief|Chief]]'s Brilliant [[Foods#Pumpkins|Pumpkin]] Plan."

The leaders of [[Skypiea]]'s once-warring factions share [[Foods/Beverages#Pumpkin Juice|pumpkin juice]], and discuss how to rebuild and improve the land's agriculture.

==Short Summary==
[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] defeats [[Rob Lucci]].

==Long Summary==
[[Usopp]] calls out to [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] to wake up. The [[Marines]] still on the [[Marine Ships|ships]] are stunned, as the [[pirate]]s are defeating their [[Captain (Marine Rank)|captains]] with ease. Luffy looks up and sees Usopp looking down at him, surprised to see his friend there. Usopp still tries to sound bitter at Luffy, and tells him he only came to rescue [[Nico Robin|Robin]] and not to see him. Usopp then challenges [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]] to a fight. Luffy tries to tell Usopp not to try and fight him, but Lucci tells him he has no business with someone who has been defeated, and everyone will soon be dead anyway. Luffy tells Usopp not to fight him as he will be killed. Usopp tells Luffy to stand up and stop pretending he is about to die. He then points out that they aren't in Hell yet. Luffy gets up, as the soldiers and [[Vice Admiral]] [[Momonga]] watch the pirates fight the captains.

Lucci is surprised that Luffy can still move. He then uses '''[[Seimei Kikan#Rob Lucci|Seimei Kikan: Kaijo]]''' to bring himself to full power. Lucci uses '''Shigan "Madara"''', which Luffy counters with '''Gomu Gomu no Gatling'''. Lucci then brings two fists forward and stops them in front of Luffy. Luffy feels determined not to get hit by '''Rokuogan''' again, but Lucci uses a technique called '''[[Six Powers/Rokuogan#Variations|Sai Dai Rin: Rokuogan]]''', the most powerful form of '''Rokuogan'''. To Lucci's amazement, Luffy is still standing. Luffy then remembers what [[Kuzan|Aokiji]] told him about how he would soon regret taking in Nico Robin as part of his [[Straw Hat Pirates|crew]]. He then remembers Robin's involvement in the whole thing from shooting [[Iceburg]] up until now. Lucci uses '''[[Six Powers/Tekkai|Tekkai]]''', but it is instantly penetrated by Luffy's '''[[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 2 Techniques#Pre-Timeskip|Gomu Gomu no Jet Gatling]]'''. Rob Lucci is punched into and through the wall. Lucci and Luffy land on the ground outside where they were fighting. Lucci is unconscious. Luffy then calls out to Robin that they are going back together, causing her to tearfully smile. The chapter ends with the [[Marine Ships#Battleship|battleships]] reporting the defeat of Rob Lucci.
